findings.quote: Artificial intelligence must be inseparable from human rights, security, equal opportunity, and accountability.
findings.rationale: Advocates human-centered AI and international dialogue on rights, security, and accountability.

findings.quote: Today, in an era when social networks and artificial intelligence are spreading hatred and stereotypes at a rapid pace, it is important to remind this truth once again.
findings.rationale: Identifies AI spreading hatred and stereotypes while promoting intercultural dialogue.
